newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian 10-year bond ylds break 5.75 pct barrier.
newsitem.headline: Belgian 10-year bond ylds break 5.75 pct barrier.

text.p: A larger-than-expected drop in expectations of U.S. purchasing managers in June helped European bond markets stage a late rally on Tuesday, with dealers saying Thursday's U.S. employment report was now the only factor standing in the way of lower yields.

The June NAPM index, which came in at 55.7 versus 57.1 last month and expectations of around 56.4, sent the Belgian 10-year yield down from early levels around 5.78 percent to 5.73 percent by 1500 GMT. The 5.75 percent level, which some had seen as a barrier in recent weeks, had now been swept aside, one dealer said. "It's not going to keep the market where it is," he said.
